bio.text: Rosie Pino, a Clifton city councilwoman, won the Republican primary in New Jersey's 9th Congressional District and will face Democratic Rep. Nellie Pou in the general election.
The Associated Press called the race for Pino over attorney Tiffany Burress on June 12, 2026.
Pino is a former Democrat who said she left that party for the Republican Party.

sources.title: Rosie Pino wins GOP primary in New Jersey's 9th District to challenge Democratic Rep. Nellie Pou
